description: Governance policy from Stage 5 deciding which recipe data must always be reachable through the fast/default search path (tier=hot) vs. the archival path (tier=lt), and how confident a hot-only search must be before answering without escalating to the full corpus.

history.approved_by: TBD -- record the actual approver here
history.rule: tier = 'hot' if recipe.cautions is non-empty (any allergen caution present), else 'lt'. See 05_governance_hot_lt_tiering/ingest.py assign_tier().
history.notes: Initial policy, introduced with Stage 5. Thresholds tuned against the 260-recipe sample corpus, where an exact name/source match scores ~22-28 and a loose incidental word-overlap match scores ~3-9.
